title: Batch B stayed trusted but regressed from the -15 frontier after the nested retry fix; pivot to adjacent systems
symptom: The bounded nested blocked-prereq retry fix cleared the config KeyError reproducer and the full Batch B rerun completed cleanly, but the trustworthy overlap surface worsened from the prior -15 frontier to overlap_verified_delta = -22 on campaign 54e06dab. No overlap regressions were recovered and 14 additional overlap regressions appeared across config, workflow, reporting, and pricing. This means the fix was valid as a state-correctness repair but non-fruitful as a Batch B improvement lane. The next step should no longer be another replay-hygiene tweak on the same theory; it should pivot to documented adjacent systems whose fit is now directly supported by the campaign attribution report.
trust_impact: The run is trustworthy enough to block promotion, to block Batch C, and to justify a documented adjacent-system pivot. The issue is not measurement noise.
